ios.desc:
* quickly go through you screenshots to:
 - delete
 - categorize
 - skip
* as you add Screenshots to categories, AI will learn and recommand categories
* delete screenshots from Photos, save device space
* set reminders for your Screenshots
* mark as done, filter and manage your Screenshots
* use camera with AI category suggestions
* register and share your list


All photos are securely encrypted and stored on the server.

https://visuel.world

https://apps.apple.com/pl/app/photo-notes-visuel/id6446812880

I don’t like typing so I’m experimenting with camera, and screenshot organizing for productivity.

It’s my weekend project, but I’m trying to update at least once a month. So far works for me for collecting gift ideas or stuff I see in real life and want to check online later.
